external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: A supplier that uploads compliance paperwork and signs in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: A corporate category manager who reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the portal and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service that loads the nightly supplier extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where supplier compliance documents remain stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organization's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: A supplier uploads compliance paperwork and staff contact details to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: A category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description says the nightly extract is encrypted end to end; the landing bucket runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is. These claims conflict for the extract's protection in transit.

data_flows.name: load data file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the supplier extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write supplier records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because the text calls it a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the system as a supplier portal.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform's data classification is confidential because it stores compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket's data classification is confidential because it stores supplier data extracts containing staff contact details and compliance-related records.
assumptions.basis: The bucket receives the supplier data extract derived from the supplier paperwork and contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database's data classification is confidential because it stores supplier records derived from supplier data and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the database, and the described supplier data includes staff contact details.
